Two clean ruled notes pages; plain writing space has value without decorative boxes.
A real imprint with accurate creator and asset credits. Do not invent an ISBN, collaborators, edition history or printer facts.

recommended_additions_in_priority_order.purpose: Restore explicit book identity, A1 beginner level, author and Brighton/Wingfield provenance. Fresh cover image can echo the adult horizon metaphor without copying the watermarked photo.
State verified author and series name, Brighton association and image/audio credits locations. Old 2025 imprint is evidence, not a reason to misdate the new edition.
List all eight units, all lesson titles/codes, review spreads, main language and communicative outcomes with actual page links; separately locate grammar, vocabulary and practical banks.

One visual annotated spread or concise guide to A/C language, B receptive skills, D writing/speaking; audio badges, New Words, Go-to practice and Extra Practice. Do not reintroduce an unsolicited Before class routine.
Use the verified existing HTML viewer and its actual audio playback; explain printed QR access without promising an app or assigning fake access codes. Blooket spaces remain future reserves.
A small usable bank for asking for repetition, spelling, meaning, help and checking understanding, with full natural models rather than grammar fragments.
Organize actual taught pronunciation patterns and usable examples; enough for lookup without overloading A1 with a full technical phonetics course.
A course-aligned alphabetic infinitive/past table with complete short model sentences or context groups. Use verbs evidenced in current Units7–8 and banks, not a generic 100-word B1 appendix.
A concise alphabetical grammar and vocabulary topic index with actual lesson/page destinations. It should complement the contents instead of duplicating every word bank.
An eight-unit can-do checklist connecting learning to concrete tasks and room to note a next goal; a concise course closure, not a new workbook.
Two clean ruled pages with enough spacing to write by hand, matching the book footer and visual identity.

preservation_guidance: Keep current lesson artwork, meaningful activities, recordings and revised grammar chart standards.
